Team Name Generator

Generate catchy team names by style — funny, professional, punny, animal, fantasy or tech — with an optional keyword woven in.

Click any name to copy it.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a naming style.
  2. Optionally add a keyword to include.
  3. Press Generate and click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the names made?

Choose a style (funny, professional, punny, animal, fantasy, tech) and the generator combines curated word lists for that vibe.

Can I include my own word?

Type a keyword and it is woven into the generated names wherever it fits naturally.

Can I get more names?

Press Generate again for a fresh batch — combinations are randomized every time.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
